tools.name: terminal_status
tools.description: Check local Terminal-rs app availability, active layout, provider and read-only status. Never changes application state.

tools.name: terminal_quote
tools.description: Fetch current observed market prices from Terminal-rs providers, including actual source and timestamp. Read-only; may be delayed.

tools.name: terminal_history
tools.description: Retrieve up to 250 historical OHLCV bars for a market symbol. Read-only and source-dependent.

tools.name: terminal_search
tools.description: Search market instruments using Terminal-rs sources. No orders or transactions.

tools.name: terminal_book
tools.description: Inspect a public market order book, not personal orders. Read-only; some sources may provide simulated books, flagged as such.

tools.name: terminal_watchlist
tools.description: Inspect, add or remove symbols in the RUNNING local Terminal-rs app watchlist. Does not trade.

tools.name: terminal_screen
tools.description: Set a watchlist analysis filter in the RUNNING app: UP/DOWN/MOVE percent, VOL ratio, SMA, RSI, freshness and sorting.

tools.name: terminal_alert
tools.description: Manage local one-shot price or daily technical alerts in the RUNNING app. Does not submit trades.

tools.name: terminal_open_chart
tools.description: Display a security in the RUNNING Terminal-rs GUI chart. No execution functionality.

tools.name: terminal_app_quotes
tools.description: Inspect already-loaded market quotes in the RUNNING app without forcing a network request or trading.
